study type: Cross-sectional (human), in vitro, and animal model study
cohort: The human cohort included 39 pregnant patients with Hypertensive Disorder Complicating Pregnancy (HDCP) and 39 normal pregnant controls.
finding: The study found that SIRT5-mediated PRKAA2 succinylation modulates placental cell apoptosis in HDCP, suggesting PRKAA2 is a potential therapeutic target.
cross-section timing: Chorionic villi samples were collected within 30 minutes of delivery.
gest_age: HDCP patients were at 32-40 weeks of gestation, and normal controls were at 37-42 weeks of pregnancy.
